description: This Java class implements a service providing dropdown options for loan-related configurations in a loan management system. It defines methods to retrieve various enumeration options for loan amortization, interest types, repayment schedules, recalculations, and rescheduling strategies, among others.

classes.name: LoanDropdownReadPlatformServiceImpl
classes.description: A service class implementing dropdown options for loan configurations and enumerations.

methods.name: retrieveLoanAmortizationTypeOptions
methods.description: Returns options for loan amortization types such as equal installments and equal principal.

methods.name: retrieveLoanInterestTypeOptions
methods.description: Returns options for interest calculation methods like flat and declining balance.

methods.name: retrieveLoanInterestRateCalculatedInPeriodOptions
methods.description: Provides options for interest calculation frequency within periods.

methods.name: retrieveLoanTermFrequencyTypeOptions
methods.description: Returns options for loan term frequencies such as days, weeks, months, and years.

methods.name: retrieveRepaymentFrequencyTypeOptions
methods.description: Provides options for repayment frequency like days, weeks, months.

methods.name: retrieveRepaymentFrequencyOptionsForNthDayOfMonth
methods.description: Returns options representing the Nth day of the month for repayment scheduling.

methods.name: retrieveRepaymentFrequencyOptionsForDaysOfWeek
methods.description: Provides options for repayment days based on days of the week.

methods.name: retrieveInterestRateFrequencyTypeOptions
methods.description: Returns options for interest rate frequency such as months, years, whole term.

methods.name: retrieveLoanCycleValueConditionTypeOptions
methods.description: Provides options for cycle value conditions like equal and greater than.

methods.name: retrieveInterestRecalculationCompoundingTypeOptions
methods.description: Provides options for interest recalculation compounding methods.

methods.name: retrieveInterestRecalculationNthDayTypeOptions
methods.description: Returns options for the Nth day in interest recalculations.

methods.name: retrieveInterestRecalculationDayOfWeekTypeOptions
methods.description: Provides options for days of week in interest recalculations.

methods.name: retrieveRescheduleStrategyTypeOptions
methods.description: Returns options for loan rescheduling strategies.

methods.name: retrieveInterestRecalculationFrequencyTypeOptions
methods.description: Provides options for interest recalculation frequency such as daily, weekly, monthly.

methods.name: retrievePreCloseInterestCalculationStrategyOptions
methods.description: Returns options for pre-close interest calculation strategies.

methods.name: retrieveRepaymentStartDateTypeOptions
methods.description: Provides options for the start date of repayments.
